Name: kick_steamid_tracker
Author: 250de360
Description: Tracks Steam64 IDs of players who joined your lobby. Requires Bingus Shared Loader (v15+). 'API 1' is the loader's own API level, printed in BingusSharedLoader.log, not a second mod.

Options.Name: kick_steamid_tracker
Options.Description: Track and log peer Steam IDs.
